dslRule:
<!id: java.lang.Thread.getId-to-threadId>
<!description: Replaces java.lang.Thread.getId() with java.lang.Thread.threadId() as getId() is deprecated for removal since Java 19 and threadId() provides the same functionality. This cleanup is only applied if the target expression is explicitly of type java.lang.Thread.
>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!minJavaVersion: 19>

$x.getId() :: sourceVersionGE(19) && instanceof($x, "java.lang.Thread")
=> $x.threadId()
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
